plan.matching: Exact recorded other macros, fiber zero, breakfast, amount consumed 100.
plan.calibration: First available low and high dose; both responses finish before either query.
plan.query: First later low and first later high dose; no repeated reuse within a macro/person.
plan.conversion: Two-point affine inverse, clip only at zero. Zero feature contrast means abstention, counted as failure.
plan.selection: Feature choices fixed from preceding audit. No test-driven feature or sign selection.
plan.limitation: Exploratory repeated controlled recipes; not unseen-portion or arbitrary-meal validation.
